title: The Two-Week Notice Rule Has Changed. Do THIS Instead.
description:
Two weeks' notice used to be the professional standard. That's changing. If you quit your job today, you need to know what companies actually do the moment you resign - and why giving automatic notice may be costing you more than you think. Corporate recruiter with 20 years inside Amazon, FedEx, and Korn Ferry breaks down the new rules and exactly what to do instead.

The double standard is real. Companies will walk you out with a security escort the same day they let you go — no notice, no warning, no transition period. But they still expect two weeks from you when you decide to leave.

This video explains why I no longer give automatic two-week notices, when it still makes sense to give notice, and the exact framework I'd follow if I were quitting a job today.

Want help with your job search? Visit https://alifeafterlayoff.com
